# Getting help

- **Questions**: how to run, configure or extend harnessly. Ask in [Discussions, Q&A][qa]; search there and in
  [the docs](../docs/README.md) first, an answered question helps the next person too.
- **Bugs**: something does not work as documented. [Open a bug report][bug] with the release or commit, the runtime
  mode and the steps to reproduce.
- **Ideas**: something harnessly should do. [A feature request][feature], or a thread in [Discussions, Ideas][ideas]
  when it needs talking through first.
- **Security problems**: never in public. [Report them privately][advisory], see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

[qa]: https://github.com/ly-solutions/harnessly/discussions/categories/q-a
[ideas]: https://github.com/ly-solutions/harnessly/discussions/categories/ideas
[bug]: https://github.com/ly-solutions/harnessly/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml
[feature]: https://github.com/ly-solutions/harnessly/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml
[advisory]: https://github.com/ly-solutions/harnessly/security/advisories/new
